injuries.note: day-to-day

injuries.name: Jiri Kulich
injuries.note: Kulich missed Saturday's 4-3 overtime loss to Washington and won't join his teammates for the California portion of Buffalo's road trip. The Sabres visit San Jose on Tuesday, Anaheim on Thursday and Los Angeles on Saturday. It's unclear when Kulich will be available to return to the lineup. He has one goal, two assists, nine shots on net, three blocked shots and seven hits in eight appearances this season.

injuries.name: Sam Carrick
injuries.note: ir

injuries.name: Alex Lyon
injuries.note: According to the team, Lyon was originally expected to be in the crease for Tuesday's road clash with Montreal before suffering his setback. Even once given the all-clear, there may not be enough games to go around to make Lyon more than a low-end fantasy target, especially as long as Buffalo continues rostering three goalies.

injuries.name: Matt Grzelcyk
injuries.note: Buffalo placed Grzelcyk on injured reserve Tuesday. He hasn't played since Opening Night against Columbus on Oct. 1. With Rasmus Dahlin (upper body) and Grzelcyk unavailable, the Sabres recalled Dennis Gilbert from AHL Rochester to play against Montreal on Tuesday.

injuries.name: Conor Timmins
injuries.note: After getting hurt in Saturday's preseason finale against Pittsburgh, Timmins is on injured reserve for the beginning of the 2026-27 campaign. He registered eight assists, 44 shots on goal, 81 blocked shots and 29 hits in 39 regular-season appearances with Buffalo in 2025-26.

injuries.note: ir-nr

injuries.note: ir

injuries.name: Alexander Wennberg
injuries.note: ir

injuries.name: Quentin Musty
injuries.note: It was relayed Sept. 17 that Musty will be out long term due to his upper-body injury, so his placement on IR-NR doesn't come as a surprise. The 21-year-old had a relatively solid first full season with AHL San Jose in 2025-26, accounting for 21 goals, 45 points and a minus-14 rating over 61 regular-season games. The left-shot winger will likely continue his development with the Barracuda once he moves past his injury.

injuries.name: Kyle Keyser
injuries.note: The Sharks announced in mid-September that Keyser was facing a long-term absence due to an upper-body injury, so his placement on non-roster injured reserve isn't particularly surprising. Once he's cleared to return, the 27-year-old will likely report to AHL San Jose.

injuries.name: Sam Carrick
injuries.note: Upper Body: The Buffalo Sabres placed F Sam Carrick on injured reserve on Wednesday (Oct. 21).

injuries.name: Justin Danforth
injuries.note: Upper-Body: Danforth won't play versus the Sharks on Tuesday (Oct. 27), Rachel Lenzi of The Buffalo News reports.

injuries.name: Matt Grzelcyk
injuries.note: Lower-Body: The Buffalo Sabres placed D Matt Grzelcyk on injured reserve on Tuesday (Oct. 13).

injuries.name: Jiri Kulich
injuries.note: Concussion: Kulich has been placed in concussion protocol, per Rachel Lenzi of The Buffalo News on Monday (Oct. 26).

injuries.name: Alex Lyon
injuries.note: Upper-body: The Buffalo Sabres said on Thursday's (Oct. 15) that Lyon had a setback in his recovery and is without a timeline to return.

injuries.name: Jack Rathbone
injuries.note: Undisclosed: The Buffalo Sabres placed D Jack Rathbone on injured reserve non-roster list on Monday (Sep. 28).

injuries.name: Conor Timmins
injuries.note: Lower-body: The Buffalo Sabres placed D Conor Timmins on injured reserve and does not have a timeline for his return yet, according to Heather Engel of NHL.com.

injuries.name: Igor Chernyshov
injuries.note: Upper Body: The Sharks reported on Saturday (Oct. 24) that Chernyshov is week-to-week, per Sheng Peng of San Jose Hockey Now.

injuries.name: Kyle Keyser
injuries.note: Upper body: The San Jose Sharks placed G Kyle Keyser on injured reserve.

injuries.name: Quentin Musty
injuries.note: Upper body: The San Jose Sharks placed F Quentin Musty on injured reserve non-roster list.

injuries.name: Alexander Wennberg
injuries.note: Upper body: The Sharks said on Thursday (Oct. 22) that Wennberg has been deemed week-to-week by head coach Ryan Warsofsky, per Curtis Pashelka of The San Jose Mercury News.
